subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should this conflicted aggregate remain the landing vehicle after preserving current main’s mobile fixes, or should its unique gateway, session, tool-gate, and gate-repair deltas be split into narrower current-main PRs?
rationale: Both integration shapes are technically viable, but the choice changes auditability and the risk of obscuring authorization or mobile-state regressions during conflict resolution.

options.title: Repair Aggregate
options.body: Resolve around current main’s mobile implementation and retain the unique replay, authorization, and gate-repair commits together with exact-head proof.

options.title: Split Remaining Deltas
options.body: Extract the unique session replay, fail-closed tool-gate, and gate-repair work into narrow current-main PRs if the aggregate cannot remain easy to audit.

recommendation.title: Repair Aggregate
recommendation.body: Resolve around current main’s mobile implementation and retain the unique replay, authorization, and gate-repair commits together with exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows ownership of both the aggregate stack and the overlapping current-main mobile implementation, making this person the strongest available integration decision owner.
